clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Devouring Plague training begins with Ur'kyo sending Forsaken priests home. They have come to Kalimdor to learn from the Darkspear, but Aelthalyste waits in Undercity to teach them the shadow arts of their own people.

Ur'kyo guides those drawn to spiritual power in Orgrimmar. Among the Horde, Darkspear trolls and Forsaken share a curious bond in matters of faith, while orcs and tauren show little inclination toward priestly worship. Ur'kyo knows Forsaken initiates must master the shadow arts tied to their own condition. In respect between their peoples, he sends wandering Forsaken back to Lordaeron to complete their training.

Beneath Lordaeron's ruins, Priestess Aelthalyste tends the flock in Undercity's War Quarter. Forsaken priests follow a solitary, grueling path shaped by their turn to shadow. They endure the painful touch of the Holy Light and learn to wield the devastating affliction of Shadow magic. When an initiate gains sufficient prowess, Aelthalyste gathers them close and teaches the affliction her kind calls Devouring Plague.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.
You return to the Undercity, friend. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good, you've returned, and not a moment too late. We have great things to discuss, friend. Your abilities are growing stronger, and we must make sure you are ready.
